description_en: Obtains the node logs of a pipeline job
description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点运行产生的日志
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-run-node-logs --pipeline-run-id flow-7318600000000nku43 --node-id node-hh5yc00000000mz8ms --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRunNodeLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node on which the pipeline job is executed. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务节点ID。如何获取节点ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The offset from which the data is returned. Default value: 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of logs returned per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的开始时间，格式为时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: from_time_in_seconds

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the logs are sorted in descending order. Valid values:

false: The logs are sorted in ascending order. This is the default value.
true: The logs are sorted in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
是否倒排，取值如下：
false（默认值）：正序排列日志。
true：倒序排列日志
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的结束时间，格式为时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: to_time_in_seconds

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID
parameters.name: token_id

Logs.description_en: The list of the returned logs
